notes.title: Sips and Sonnets is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: [p]Our second game Sips and Sonnets is out now! [/p][p][/p][p]It took 12 months, lots of love, and the hard work of a wonderful group of talented collaborators![/p][p][/p][p]Please buy it, tell your friends about it, and leave a review 💙[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/2c9adf89a7e4c6c5d975873f43e05307ffef70bb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p]Blue Tango Street [/p]

notes.title: Sips and Sonnets is coming September 12th, 2025! ✨
notes.notes: [p]We are delighted to announce the release date trailer for our upcoming game, [i]Sips and Sonnets[/i], now on IGN's GameTrailer's channel! Coming to Steam for Windows and Mac on [b]September 12th, 2025[/b]. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/c1a283eb6fff959420a7c2e8c683f0e7800f7d57.gif"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PcU9AqFEKzE&ab_channel=GameTrailers" style="button"]Sips and Sonnets - Release Date Trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Sips and Sonnets is a fully voiced cozy visual novel with tea brewing mechanics, branching dialogue, and a poetry minigame. Starring two legendary actors: [i]Bethan Dixon Bate[/i] (Queen Vlaakith from Baldur’s Gate 3, Sienna from Warhammer: Vermintide) and [i]Lenval[/i] [i]Brown[/i] (the velvety-voiced psyche in Disco Elysium).[/p][p][/p][p]Inspired by our personal experiences with local tea shops across the United Kingdom, as well as countless wholesome interactions with kind and wise role models in our lives, this heartfelt visual novel tells a side less told, of a life well lived, and a youth come and gone.[/p][p][/p][p]Fun fact, we started developing Sips and Sonnets Sep 12, 2024, exactly [i]one year ago[/i]! This visual novel was made possible thanks to collaborating with a group of talented people! We hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it 🤗[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/227a8190eeaa47df6a0b9f551e1b4c34962341fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Much Love, [/p][p]Blue Tango Street [/p]

notes.title: Bethan Dixon Bate and Lenval Brown Joining Voice Cast!
notes.notes: [p]We’re very excited to announce the joining of two legendary voice actors to Sips and Sonnets![/p][p][/p][p]Starring Bethan Dixon Bate as Miss Meadows, and Lenval Brown as one of her two best friends, Ollie! You may know Bethan as Queen Vlaakith from Baldur's Gate 3 and Sienna from Warhammer: Vermintide, and Lenval Brown as the narrator of Disco Elysium![/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to play it and experience it with full voice acting! Coming out very soon! 😄🫖✍️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/864991a2cf5f7eabb113be4cab8845cefd3f8d8c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With Love,[/p][p]Blue Tango Street[/p]

notes.title: Demo Release for Steam Next Fest Jun 2025!
notes.notes: [p]Hello all![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to take part in Steam Next Fest June 2025 Edition! A demo is now LIVE![/p][p]In this demo, you will get to play one day in Ms. Meadows' life! You'll meet the first customer, chat, make tea, and write poetry inspired by your interaction! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/8eb422f729c10a0690315c084338e7fcde56f6e2.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this glimpse of the game while we gear up to releasing it fully later this year![/p][p][/p][p]Much love, [/p][p]Blue Tango Street [/p]
